mapper.select: SELECT project_id, project_name, project_description, approval_status, reject_reason, project_status, start_date, end_date, target_amount, created_at, user_id, category_id FROM project WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.update: UPDATE project p SET p.project_status = CASE WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.reward_price), 0) FROM funding f JOIN reward r ON r.reward_id = f.reward_id WHERE f.project_id = p.project_id) >= p.target_amount THEN 'success' ELSE 'fail' END WHERE p.approval_status = 'approved' AND p.project_status = 'in_progress' AND p.end_date < #{today}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project (project_name, project_description, approval_status, start_date, end_date, target_amount, user_id, category_id) VALUES (#{projectName}, #{projectDescription, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'draft', #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{targetAmount}, #{userId}, #{categoryId})
mapper.update: UPDATE project SET approval_status = 'waiting', reject_reason = NULL WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND approval_status IN ('draft', 'reject')
UPDATE project SET approval_status = 'approved', project_status = 'in_progress', reject_reason = NULL WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND approval_status = 'waiting'
mapper.select:
SELECT p.project_id, p.project_name, c.category_name, u.user_name AS maker_name, p.project_status, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.target_amount, COALESCE(t.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(t.supporter_count, 0) AS supporter_count, COALESCE(l.like_count, 0) AS like_count, CASE WHEN p.project_status = 'in_progress' AND p.end_date >= #{today} THEN '펀딩중' ELSE '펀딩종료' END AS supporter_state FROM project p JOIN category c ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN `user` u ON u.user_id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT f.project_id, SUM(r.reward_price) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS supporter_count FROM funding f JOIN reward r ON r.reward_id = f.reward_id GROUP BY f.project_id) t ON t.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS like_count FROM project_like GROUP BY project_id) l ON l.project_id = p.project_id
p.approval_status = 'approved'
AND p.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND p.project_status = 'in_progress' AND p.end_date >= #{today}
AND (p.project_status IN ('success', 'fail') OR p.end_date < #{today})
AND p.project_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY total_amount DESC, p.project_id DESC ORDER BY p.end_date ASC, p.project_id DESC ORDER BY like_count DESC, p.project_id DESC ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.project_id DESC
